turn1.explanation: The unit responds to frontal faces of small-to-medium furry mammals (cats, foxes, red pandas, hamsters, mustelids), keyed to the eyes-over-snout layout. It also fires on a face-like car front, likely because headlights and grille mimic that layout.
turn1.evidence: 19 of 20 top crops are front-facing furry animal faces, centered on the eyes and nose. The one exception (#5, activation 9) is a car front, whose two headlights above a central grille resemble a face.
turn1.missing_data: Lower-ranked and mid-range activations, and responses to more frontal car views and to non-furry or human faces, would show whether car fronts are a real secondary trigger or a one-off.
